testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.mechanics.pvp.breach.BreachRewardTests

testcase.name: points go to the top 100 by damage, a different ranking from loot
emblem needs 250 damage - 249 does not qualify
each eligible player's roll is independent - the same seed gives the same loot whatever others roll
points are one per damage and stop at the 75,000 lifetime cap
loot eligibility is the first 16 damage dealers, not the 16 biggest
the schedule file matches the default and daylight saving never moves an opening
exactly 16 attackers are all eligible and the 17th never is
Audit D-14 - one Archaic emblem per account per breach event, however many monsters
a relog keeps the same slot and adds up, zero hits claim nothing
emblem trade-in points are spending money outside the damage cap
poison and venom immunities follow the wiki infoboxes
